dogecoin.text:
@greenhkd @nbcsnl @dogecoin Weekend update has been the best part of SNL for a while and I feel like it was watching a bunch of sell outs.

I seen Michael Che live and he was one of the best raw comedians and I've seen them all now.

It doesn't make sense.

I hope they all lost money.

Was the @nbcsnl cast invested in @dogecoin? 

That was the most pathetic episode I've seen of Saturday Night Live in thirty years.

I was excited for next week too, why did they do this to me?
